description: This file defines the PidFd class used for managing process IDs, launching subprocesses, and interacting with process file descriptors in the Android Cuttlefish sandbox environment.
external_methods: absl::StatusOr<PidFd> PidFd::LaunchSubprocess(absl::Span<const std::string>, std::vector<std::pair<sapi::file_util::fileops::FDCloser, int>>, absl::Span<const std::string>)

classes.name: PidFd
classes.description: A class to manage process IDs, launch subprocesses, and interact with process file descriptors within the sandbox environment.

methods.name: FromRunningProcess
methods.description: Returns a managed pidfd tracking a previously started process identified by pid.

methods.name: LaunchSubprocess
methods.description: Launches a subprocess and returns a pidfd tracking the new process.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with this PidFd.

methods.name: AllFds
methods.description: Copies file descriptors from the target process to the current process.

methods.name: Argv
methods.description: Retrieves the argument vector for the process.

methods.name: Env
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables for the process.

methods.name: HaltHierarchy
methods.description: Halts the process and all its descendants.

methods.name: HaltChildHierarchy
methods.description: Halts only the descendants of the process.

methods.name: SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the process.
